search_results.title: Grid-Scale Battery Plant Comes Online
search_results.snippet: A new grid-scale battery storage facility began operating, adding enough capacity to power roughly 60,000 homes during peak demand.

search_results.title: Direct Air Capture Plant Breaks Ground
search_results.snippet: Construction started on a direct air capture facility designed to remove carbon dioxide directly from the atmosphere at megaton scale.

search_results.title: Cities Pilot Heat Pump Retrofit Subsidy
search_results.snippet: Several cities launched a pilot subsidy program covering part of the cost of replacing gas furnaces with electric heat pumps in older homes.

search_results.title: Offshore Wind Project Clears Final Permit
search_results.snippet: An offshore wind project received its final regulatory permit, clearing the way for construction to begin next year.
